skills.description: This skill should be used when setting up or fixing Docker-via-colima autostart on macOS, especially when colima fails to come up after a shutdown or restart with the error 'vz driver is running but host agent is not'. It provides a hardened LaunchAgent wrapper that clears stale lima or VZ instance state on boot, then keeps the VM alive with a monitoring loop. Trigger phrases include 'colima 重启失败', 'Docker 关机后起不来', 'colima autostart', 'vz driver is running but host agent is not', or any request to make colima survive macOS reboots.
